name: pages-native
description: Native Apple Pages documents through the macOS scripting API. Preview verified on Pages 14.5.
long_description: 36 native tools for .pages documents: guarded edits, structured search, guided templates with typed table fields, reusable recipes, batches of up to 10 new documents, local recipe history and restoration, objects, explicit exports and PDF/PNG previews. Requires macOS, Apple Pages, Node.js 22+ and Automation permission. Verified configurations are documented separately. No Accessibility or Word conversion backend; named paragraph styles are not exposed.
